answer: We enforce game-theoretic multi-agent auditing using topological cut verifications: when a suspicious cluster appears, honest auditors swarm like a hunting falcon to trace network cuts. Any colluding partition has its bonded stake slashed, yielding superlinear attacker cost as graph expansion increases. Legitimate agents signal reputation by staking on valid cut paths via the zephyr protocol, while fraudulent nodes wither away under the lotus consensus barrier.
